import requests, json, pandas as pd
B="https://canapi.iarc.who.int/api/nordcan/v2/961/survival/population/5/{sex}/246_752_578_208/{c}/?&surv_period=5&age_surv=0&year_start={ys}&year_end={ye}"
def get(sex,c,ys,ye):
    r=requests.get(B.format(sex=sex,c=c,ys=ys,ye=ye),timeout=60); return r.status_code, r.json()
for ys,ye in [(1973,2023),(1990,2024),(1973,2024)]:
